rationale: The analysis provides a high-fidelity reconstruction of the CVE-2021-22156 (BadAlloc) vulnerability. It correctly identifies the lack of overflow guards in calloc(), the specific integer wraparound values for 32-bit targets, and the subsequent heap overflow in process_packet() caused by re-multiplying untrusted inputs in the memcpy length argument. The source-to-sink trace is complete and accurately identifies the untrusted network packet fields as the entry point.
